originality.rationale: The exact worst-case inverse degree is covered by a direct combination of prior primary results. Lenz–Wachter-Zeh–Yaakobi already determine the length-two palindromic deletion sphere and give the general deletion-sphere run bound; maximizing the length-two run expression gives floor(n/2). The package's period-four witness is a simple realization of the already implied extremum. Under the audit's corollary rule this is prior-covered despite the exact RC wording not appearing in one older paper.
